templates.title: Documenso
templates.name: documenso
templates.description: Documenso v2.19.0 is an open-source document signing platform backed by PostgreSQL.

env.name: PORT
env.label: PORT
env.description: Port Documenso listens on inside the container.

env.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.label: NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: Primary encryption key. At least 32 characters.

env.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_SECONDARY_KEY
env.label: NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_SECONDARY_KEY
env.description: Secondary encryption key. At least 32 characters.

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL
env.label: NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL
env.description: Public URL where browsers reach Documenso.

env.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_INTERNAL_WEBAPP_URL
env.label: NEXT_PRIVATE_INTERNAL_WEBAPP_URL
env.description: URL the app uses to call itself inside the container.

env.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL
env.label: NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL
env.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Must match the database service.

env.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL
env.label: NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL
env.description: Direct PostgreSQL connection string used for migrations.

env.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_TRANSPORT
env.label: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Email transport. smtp-auth is username and password SMTP.

env.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_HOST
env.label: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_HOST
env.description: SMTP server hostname. Replace with a real server before sending mail.

env.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_USERNAME
env.label: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_USERNAME
env.description: SMTP username. Replace with the real account.

env.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_PASSWORD
env.label: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_PASSWORD
env.description: SMTP password. Replace with the real account password.

env.name: POSTGRES_USER
env.label: POSTGRES_USER
env.description: PostgreSQL user for the documenso-db service.

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.description: PostgreSQL password. Must match the database URLs.
